title: hockey-clip-review blinded judge verdict
description: One judge's verdict on one blinded judge packet (packets/<incident_id>/judge-<judge>.json). Candidates are the anonymous clips A.mp4, B.mp4, ... in the packet; context.mp4 is a wider window for reference. Overall score (the main number): how good the clip is as a highlight a fan wants to watch. 10 = the clip shows the whole event from the start of the play to the end of the celebration/whistle with nothing extra; 0 = the event is not in the clip. Primary rule for goals: the clip must show the build-up, from the start of the scoring play (zone entry, possession change, or the faceoff win that led to it), normally at least 15 s before the puck goes in. A goal clip that starts too late and misses the build-up gets the starts_late flag and scores at most 5, even if the goal itself is visible. Starting a little early is a much smaller fault than starting late. Flags use the same list as the human judging page; starts_late means 'starts too late, missing the build-up' and is the primary flag. Sub-scores, 0-10 each: build_up (starts where the play that produced the event starts; for goals >= 15 s before the goal, earlier when the play builds), moment (the goal, foul or fight is clearly visible), ending (the celebration or the call is shown, not cut off), cleanliness (no dead air, replays, logo wipes or glitches; the right incident).

judge.description: free label for this judge run, e.g. sonnet-1

event_seen_in_context.description: is the game-sheet event visible anywhere in context.mp4

event_context_s.description: seconds into context.mp4 where the event happens (goal: puck crosses the line; penalty: the foul or whistle; fight: gloves drop)

candidates.description: one entry per candidate letter present in the packet

build_up.description: shows the build-up: starts at the zone entry / possession change / faceoff win (goals: >= 15 s before the goal)

moment.description: the goal, foul or fight is clearly visible

ending.description: the celebration or the call is shown, not cut off

cleanliness.description: no dead air, replays, logo wipes or glitches; right incident

flags.description: starts_late = starts too late, missing the build-up (primary); correct = right event, shown whole; wrong_event; missing_goal = the event is not in the clip; ends_early = cuts the celebration or call; too_long
